coverage.interpretation: Scoped verification of original-sample MAEs and their arithmetic comparisons in the three main result tables and associated prose. Existing stars and standard-error ratios in their MAE panels are bound to the unchanged paired contrasts. Other results and the historical full-chapter mirror are outside this verification.

anchor.value: Relative to persistence, FiLM-CNN reduces its MAE by

bindings.expected_substring:
Relative to persistence, FiLM-CNN reduces its MAE by 0.0695\% in
2023Q1, 0.2592\% in 2023Q2, and 0.3561\% in 2023Q4, but increases it by
0.1033\% in 2023Q3. Pure-CNN follows the same temporal pattern, with
respective improvements of 0.0483\%, 0.1799\%, $-0.0609\%$, and 0.3393\%. For both
models, the improvement over persistence reaches the 1\% level after
Holm adjustment in 2023Q2 and only the 10\% level in 2023Q4
($p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=0.0570$), but neither level in 2023Q1 or 2023Q3. Forecast
performance is therefore period-dependent rather than uniformly better than
persistence.

anchor.value: Giving the four folds equal weight, the overall

bindings.expected_substring:
Giving the four folds equal weight, the overall
MAEs are 0.0020260002 for FiLM-CNN and 0.0020265693 for
Pure-CNN, compared with persistence at 0.0020292830.

anchor.value: Matched LP has the lowest MAE,

bindings.expected_substring:
Matched LP has the lowest MAE, 0.0020257411, followed
closely by zero text at 0.0020257684 and the Pure-CNN continuation at
0.0020259535. Relative to the Pure-CNN continuation, the matched-LP result has
a normalised MAE of 0.999895, corresponding to a descriptive
reduction of 0.0105\%. This reduction is small, and the near equality between matched LP
and zero text means that the aggregate MAE alone cannot establish that the
gain is attributable to textual information.

anchor.value: Relative to the Pure-CNN continuation, matched LP and zero text reduce the

bindings.expected_substring:
Relative to the Pure-CNN continuation, matched LP and zero text reduce the
MAE by 0.0105\% and 0.0091\%, respectively, whereas
shuffled LP increases it by 0.1067\%. All seven learned conditions have lower
MAE than persistence.

0.0020248709 under zero input and 0.0020249323
